title: Import reports the unseen revisions and remedy when a locally forgotten key meets a divergent incoming chain
outcome: Import reports the unseen revisions and remedy when a locally forgotten key meets a divergent incoming chain
acceptance: Importing a selected chain into a locally forgotten key, where the chain holds revisions missing from local history and local history is not its prefix, reports memory_concurrent_retirement (or the retirement remedy) with the unseen revision ids, covered by a behavioural test
